house.method: Import the owned position fixture through normal Settings UI, then move with native keyboard input.

before.observation: House fades; the Adventurer remains discernible behind it.

after.observation: House appearance fully restores after the Adventurer clears it; no obvious AO halo in the inspected image.

house.limitation: Qualitative smoke check of one house on High. Render size is 1920x1080 at a 1280x720 CSS viewport because native DPR 2 is capped to 1.5 on High. This check is separate from the canonical screenshots, repeatability comparison and performance samples, all captured at DPR 1. No numeric per-mesh visibility or AO-halo measurement was taken.
